effect_description_eng: [Hand] [Main] If you have a [Kiyoshiro Higashimitarai] in play, by placing 1 [TeslaJellymon] from your hand under one of your [Jellymon] as its bottom digivolution card, you may digivolve that Digimon into this card for a cost of 3, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By placing 3 cards with [Jellymon] in their text from your trash at the bottom of your deck in any order, unsuspend this Digimon.
